mstts:express-as.prosody: Welcome—I'm so glad you're here. You know, sometimes life brings us unexpected seasons—times when everything seems to slow down, and we're left searching for warmth in the midst of uncertainty. Have you ever felt that need to pause, to let yourself rest, even when the world keeps urging you to push on? Together, we're about to explore what it truly means to find strength in stillness, inspired by Katherine May's gentle wisdom in Wintering: The Power of Rest and Retreat in Difficult Times. Instead of rushing through those colder, quieter chapters of our lives, what if we learned to honor them? We'll discover how embracing periods of retreat and introspection—not as setbacks, but as essential moments of renewal—can actually help us grow. We'll look at how nature's own cycles—those long, dormant winters followed by the promise of spring—mirror our own journeys through hardship and healing. Through stories, reflections, and gentle encouragement, this is an invitation to choose rest, to welcome vulnerability, and to find hope in the quiet. So, as we step into this journey together, let's see how surrendering to our own "wintering" can open the door to unexpected resilience and a deeper understanding of ourselves—and the world around us.
